title: Module-level window.localStorage access is not guarded and can make the HostView module fail to load
test: tests/mediaDebug.test.js: 'module-scope storage read is guarded when window.localStorage throws SecurityError'
proof: On the unchanged code the new test failed with 'getLocalStorageSafely is not a function' (TypeError at mediaDebug.test.js:15): there was no guarded accessor to call. HostView cannot be imported under node:test, so the module-evaluation throw itself was not run directly; the test pins the accessor the fix adds. After the fix getLocalStorageSafely(windowLike) returns windowLike.localStorage, or null when the getter throws or the value is missing; HostView line 69 passes getLocalStorageSafely(window) to isMediaDebugEnabled instead of reading window.localStorage at module scope. isMediaDebugEnabled already tolerated null storage and wrapped getItem in try/catch, so it was not changed. The test passes after the fix, together with the existing 'shared media-debug parsing' test.
